# Route

One user-defined route in a route table (`Microsoft.Network/routeTables/routes`), written as a child
resource. The root module calls it once per route when the table holds routes Azure adds itself
(`azure_managed_routes_enabled`); it can also be called alone with a table's resource ID.

A route written this way changes only itself: the table's other routes, Azure's included, are left as
they are. Writes lock the table's ID, so a table's routes are written one at a time.

The following requirements are needed by this module:

- <a name="requirement_terraform"></a> [terraform](#requirement\_terraform) (>= 1.16, < 2.0)

- <a name="requirement_azapi"></a> [azapi](#requirement\_azapi) (~> 2.12)

## Resources

The following resources are used by this module:

- [azapi_resource.this](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/Azure/azapi/latest/docs/resources/resource) (resource)

<!-- markdownlint-disable MD013 -->
## Required Inputs

The following input variables are required:

### <a name="input_address_prefix"></a> [address\_prefix](#input\_address\_prefix)

Description: The destination: a CIDR prefix in its canonical form (`10.1.0.0/16`, not `10.1.0.1/16`; IPv6 in lower case and compressed, as Terraform's `cidrsubnet` writes it), or a service tag such as `Storage.SwedenCentral`.

Type: `string`

### <a name="input_name"></a> [name](#input\_name)

Description: Name of the route, unique in the table. Cannot be changed after creation.

Type: `string`

### <a name="input_next_hop_type"></a> [next\_hop\_type](#input\_next\_hop\_type)

Description: `VirtualAppliance`, `VirtualNetworkGateway` (a VPN gateway only, and not for IPv6 prefixes), `VnetLocal`, `Internet` (Azure accepts only public destinations, `0.0.0.0/0` or a service tag) or `None` (drop).

Type: `string`

### <a name="input_parent_id"></a> [parent\_id](#input\_parent\_id)

Description: Resource ID of the route table that holds the route.

Type: `string`

## Optional Inputs

The following input variables are optional (have default values):

### <a name="input_ignore_body_changes"></a> [ignore\_body\_changes](#input\_ignore\_body\_changes)

Description: Paths in the route's `body` whose changes the AzAPI provider ignores. Paths use dot notation, for example `properties.nextHopIpAddress`. Configuration changes at an ignored path are **not** sent to Azure until that path is removed from the list.

- `network_route_tables_routes` - Ignored body paths for the route.

Type:

```hcl
object({
    network_route_tables_routes = optional(list(string), [])
  })
```

Default: `{}`

### <a name="input_next_hop_in_ip_address"></a> [next\_hop\_in\_ip\_address](#input\_next\_hop\_in\_ip\_address)

Description: (Optional) The appliance's private IP address, for example a firewall's: required for `VirtualAppliance` and refused for every other type. In the prefix's address family, written as Terraform's `cidrhost` writes it.

Type: `string`

Default: `null`

### <a name="input_resource_types"></a> [resource\_types](#input\_resource\_types)

Description: Override the AzAPI `<provider>/<resource>@<api-version>` string used by this module.

- `network_route_tables_routes` - The route.

Type:

```hcl
object({
    network_route_tables_routes = optional(string, "Microsoft.Network/routeTables/routes@2025-07-01")
  })
```

Default: `{}`

### <a name="input_retry"></a> [retry](#input\_retry)

Description: Retry configuration for the `azapi` resource in this module. Defaults to `null` (no custom retry).

- `error_message_regex`  - (Optional) A list of regex patterns matching error messages that trigger a retry.
- `interval_seconds`     - (Optional) Initial interval between retries in seconds.
- `max_interval_seconds` - (Optional) Maximum interval between retries in seconds.

Type:

```hcl

    error_message_regex  = optional(list(string))
```

### <a name="input_timeouts"></a> [timeouts](#input\_timeouts)

Description: Per-operation timeouts for the `azapi` resource in this module. Defaults to `null` (provider defaults). Each value is a Go duration string (e.g. `30m`).

- `create` - (Optional) Timeout for create operations.
- `read`   - (Optional) Timeout for read operations.

## Outputs

The following outputs are exported:

### <a name="output_lock_dependency"></a> [lock\_dependency](#output\_lock\_dependency)

Description: Changes whenever the route is created, replaced or changed. The table passes it in its `lock_dependencies`: Azure applies the table's lock to the route too, so a `CanNotDelete` lock blocks deleting it and a `ReadOnly` lock also blocks changing it.

### <a name="output_name"></a> [name](#output\_name)

Description: Name of the route.

### <a name="output_resource_id"></a> [resource\_id](#output\_resource\_id)

Description: Resource ID of the route.

No modules.
